notes: Frame sources for packed-sprite art. Validated by tools/test-art.mjs (paths + sheet geometry + hero + enemy footprints). Loaded by js/art/load.js in the browser only. One entry per engine slot; strip = horizontal frame range of the source sheet. sheet = the engine footprint the built sheet must keep (test-boot 26.3 / 33.4.3 tables). render.artH = final art height in px (scale derived), render.trim = [x,y,w,h] crop for static battlers, render.head = [cx,top] in source-cell coords for the baseball overlay, recolour 'seat' = CFG.ghostColors paletteSwap ladder. A 'walk' strip (where the pack has real walk frames) feeds run[4]; without it run[4] reuses the idle frames + the ±1px bob derived in heroes.js. Enemy entries (33.4.3): frames = engine frame count (strip frames cycled + integer-px bob offsets where the source is static or shorter); facing 'right' = right-facing contract (every source was viewed before wiring; symmetric front-facing art is flip-invariant and satisfies it; a LEFT-facing source carries render.flip and bakeInto mirrors it); recolour 'elite' = gold skin path via palette.eliteColor + lumaTintMap (enemies.js keeps the gold-diamond tell; eliteFrames are the skin half); enemy.wolf.pack = per-coat wolfpack block (bigger footprint + own bob) tinted from PACK_PALS in characters.js. Boss entries (33.4.4/33.4.8: enemy.wraith, enemy.ryu, enemy.shark) keep the exact engine footprints (92x112/r20, 96x112/r20, 96x112/r20, 2 frames) and declare NO recolour — D105 rolls elite on non-bosses only. Large sprites may use guest-dialect sources downscaled ≤2× (PLAN-FORK §2). 'skin.<level>.<slot>' entries (skin.m02.wolf + the 33.4.8 skin.m03.* Drowned City set) are per-level re-skins of common slots: same footprint/frames as the base slot, own source strip, and the same 'elite' marker. 33.4.8 renamed Higan types (enemy.baku/kitsunebi/nue/dorotabo/amabie) are their OWN full type keys — only m02's weights reference them (world/levels.js) — carrying the exact footprint/frames of the slots they replace: left-facing Nasha stills bake through render.flip like the ryū, the Dorotabō strip is the walk sheet's measured EAST-facing row, and static single-frame sources cycle via bob[]. 33.4.8 m03 sea set (D-F5 viewings recorded in js/art/characters.js + docs): the Ocean Creatures sheet (305x368) is a 61x92-pitch grid — skin.m03.rat/bat/wolf/brute/cultist + the enemy.shark boss cut its cells via that grid pitch + measured content-rect trims (crab/clownfish/manta/dolphin/seahorse/great-white); skin.m03.goblin is Underwater Enemies pack #2's real 3-frame walk row (48x48 pitch). 'fx.snow'/'fx.petal'/'fx.bubble' (weather flake sources, blitted by entities/particles.js Snow.draw — emitter logic untouched): single-cell cuts from the Sengoku ambient-loop frames (X-snowflake; greyscale sakura petal clump declared tint "petal" = builder recolours to CFG.perf.petalColor) and the atlantis char_bubbles ring sheet. No sheet/render fields on fx entries — the builder slices the cell at native size. 33.4.5 TERRAIN entries (level tilesets; js/art/terrain.js packedGround/packedProp): 'terrain.ground.<level>' carries frame 16 + one strip per source ROW slice + a recipe {tile:256, pitch:16, seed, base:[strip,idx], scatter:[[strip,idx,weight],…]} — a deterministic patchwork of that pack's VERIFIED floor-interior cells at world.js's native tile size (the packs ship RPG-Maker autotile blocks, but the engine has no autotiler: Wang/transition rules stay unused, only seamless interior cells are consumed, and only fully-opaque cells are referenced); prefill = base-cell colour for the pre-art-ready frames. 'terrain.<prop>.<level>' cuts verified single cells (frame = measured content bbox, black cell-guide rows excluded) + place {strip, scale}; terrain.js bakes them into the exact decor-contract canvases (bottom-center, integer scale; mirror flag flips the same cell). Sources: m01 = clockworkraven 'Raven Fantasy Green Forest' All Tileset/16x16.png (26x15 free-form grid; grass cells c8/c11/c12 r0 + c8 r1; tree bbox (0,74,48,86), dead tree (64,16,48,61→44-crop), rocks (66,5)/(81,2), tent (96,112,64,63); NO autotile rules — free-form sheet). m02 = limezu Serene Village Outside.png (16px 8-col grid; r0-r2 c0-c4 grass/lawn variants). m03 = finalbossblues ATLANTIS RPGMAKER-100 (16px variant; tf_A5_atlantisA A5 flat grid: r0-r1 blue-grey city cobblestone, r14 mossy algae stone; the A2 48x48 autotile water blocks are NOT used — no autotiler). GAP LIST (kept procedural, rule 15): m01 pineBig/stump/mushroom/monolith/campfire/well + all ground decals; m02 all standing props (paulthepirateking Japanese-themed set VIEWED: walls/roofs/fences/rocks/small trees only — NO clean torii/pagoda/lantern single cells, so the own-drawn builders (plan C) stay; serenevillage props are tiny trees/flowers/signposts + indoor demo rows); m03 all standing props (atlantis sheets contain no matching kelp/coral/ruin props); mountain/lake/koi-pond/vignette landmarks are parameterized-size procedural (no fixed-size pack equivalent fits). 33.4.6 ICONS/PICKUPS (A5): icon.* and pickup.* entries carry ONE 16x16 rrfreelance "Sprites pack 16px over 150" cell (PropsInPixels_16x<N>.png) or 32x32 willYEE Sengoku weapon-icon cell (CC0; icon.tempest/cannonball). js/art/items.js buildIcons() bakes them centred into the unchanged 72x72 category-plate canvases (content bbox trimmed, nearest-neighbour, fit ~52px; entry.tint hex = lumaTintMap recolour, used ONLY for icon.blueFlame); pickup.* bake the EXACT engine sizes (render.bake = [24,26]/[22,20], test-boot 13.10 asserts) with per-level tints from GEM_PAL/HEART_PAL. LICENSE (user ruling 2026-10-26): the rrfreelance pack page states NO license terms — USE ANYWAY; the user will contact the author. Sengoku = CC0. The other 20 buildIcons() keys have no clean match in either pack and stay drawn (list in test-art). 33.4.6 SECOND PASS (A5b): icon.garlic/missile/laser/wolfpack/bat/sigil/reroll moved from drawn to packed via clockworkraven "Free - Raven Fantasy Icons" (imported 2026-10-27; 2192 unnamed icons — every cell VIEWED from indexed contact sheets of the Separated Files, D-F5; license commercial-OK per the round-1 research review). 13 keys stay drawn (no clean glyph in ANY imported pack): fangs, tongue, magnet, dash, skates, phoenix, flamingArrows, heartPiercer, stormVolley, heartMagnet, napalmMissile, staticPelt, homerKing. 35.3/35.4 (C1 — user-ordered D-F2 amendment: ALL remaining effect/impact/explosion/glow visuals packed, incl. engine-drawn): world.bolt/arrow/bullet/snowball/web/boulder/burn/blight/orb/scorch move out of kept-procedural; new engine blits fx.shieldRing/fx.garlicRing/fx.laserBeam/fx.lightningArc (game.js → combat.shieldRingImg/garlicRingImg/laserImg/arcImg — the ring bakes are scaled to 2·radius so the drawn ring keeps the TRUE radius, and the beam/arc stretch = the old vector envelopes) + fx.burstHomerun/Crag/Reflect/Ball/Slide (game.js onFx → Particles.burst — the hit-sparks/skates-marks slots; Sengoku spark-ball cell, one per-kind tint row each). Sources (all VIEWED this phase, D-F5): magic9 spark/Dark-Bolt/Fire-bomb sheets, willYEE Sengoku jp_proj_kunai + jp_spark_ball, Frostwindz lightning VFX1, pixel-magic Fire_Ball, rrfreelance PropsInPixels web/boulder cells (same cells as their card icons). Engine rows declare render.bake = the pre-baked canvas items.js hands out and the engine scales at draw (same D-F2 draw-call law). GAP (kept procedural, rule 15): baseball+HOMERUN variant (no stitched-ball art in any imported pack), boomerang (no boomerang cell), missile rocket (no rocket single cell — the pack comets are already the bullet identity), Particles dots (soul/ember/ball-trail: per-particle dynamic hue, no clean fixed-tint source), the snowball/bomb ground-shadow ellipses + hit-flash/white-out compositing (base.js helpers, PLAN-FORK §0 KEEP), and the bat/dash wind-up telegraph strokes (player silhouettes, not effects). 35.5 (D-F9 r8): the five regular small-enemy footprint families (rat+baku+m03.rat, bat+kitsunebi+m03.bat, goblin+nue+m03.goblin, brute+dorotabo+m03.brute, cultist+amabie+m03.cultist) carry sheet/artH/shadowR x1.3 (nearest int) — VISUAL-ONLY art+shadow scale (D-F2: hitboxes/stats/weights/spawns, strips, frames, bob and trims untouched). The wolf family (enemy.wolf/skin.m02.wolf/skin.m03.wolf = 192px sources), bosses, heroes and pickups stay unscaled. 36.x (2026-10-28, Phase 36 agent D1 — every source VIEWED, QA sheets under unsloth-tmp/qa-d1/): 36.1 pickup.shard = Soulshard world-pickup art SEAM from the Sengoku soul-drain collapse core (tint-declared per the blueFlame law; NO engine spawn site — Soulshards are score-derived meta currency and D-F2 keeps gameplay frozen; items.js soulShardSprite + the test-art row/bake asserts hold the seam). 36.2 ryū identity close (34.3 OPEN): enemy.ryu moved OFF aaron_fb3_002 (RED MECH — the wrong-identity defect) ONTO aaron_fb3_001, the F46 gold eastern-serpent dragon (left-facing → render.flip stands); DeepDive dragon-asset-pack VIEWED and REJECTED — its 16px wyrms read as small minions at the 96x112 boss footprint. 36.3 terrain.campfire.m01 + terrain.well.m01 packed from nanasha hunters-camp single cells (±20% footprint law + the measured reject list live in those rows). 36.4 world.baseball packed (hamuko27 Pixel Sports Ball Assets, stitched-ball cell) — baseball moved OUT of the kept-procedural list; items.js keeps the stitched-ball builder as the Node fallback and the HOMERUN variant paints the same cell under its rainbow halo (packOver under-painter). 36.5 m02-landmark fit call for the mmorwynn EAST free sample = NOT WIRED (verdict): its art is true-isometric (2:1 ground plates, its own single light, shadows shipped as separate _shadow.png files the engine would double up); measured vs the own-drawn slot canvases torii content 110x174 > 110x130 (+34% h), pagoda 140x215 > 100x170 (+40% w) — both over the ±20% law; the one size-legal cell (kasuga lantern 25x47 in the 30x56 slot) still clashes: an iso stone lantern standing beside front-view own-drawn torii/pagoda over a flat top-down packed ground (composite viewed: d1-fit-m02.png). Own-drawn m02 props STAND. 36.6 rocket body: deepdive magical-asset-pack Basic sheet + pixel-magic Icons/Molten_Spear re-checked (VIEWED) — no rocket cell; fire-spears/meteors are not a steel rocket and would collide with world.bullet owned reads — world.missile keeps its documented procedural gap.
